title: Final Constraints
description: Essential criteria include correctly identifying that there are no constraints from (a) and (b), and that a_B = 0 from (c) and (d).

title: Gauge Independence
description: Important criteria involve correctly stating that a_1 and a_2 are gauge-independent parameters.

title: Energy Density Expression
description: Essential criteria require providing the correct expression for average energy density in terms of a_1 and a_2.

title: Mathematical Consistency
description: Important criteria include ensuring that all mathematical steps leading to the constraints are correctly derived and consistent.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall criteria involve checking for common mistakes such as misidentifying constraints or incorrectly applying vector calculus identities.
